reference: eight OBB vertex mean simulator ActorBoxCenter; not mesh/contact center

matching.source: unchanged M5-N geometry-associated renderer instance; ambiguous supervision excluded, all detections retained

support.count: unique group + actor placement + model + camera; no repeated static/empty frames
support.insufficient: stop training expansion; Partial, no quality relaxation

training.selection: minimum Validation location-macro XY MAE on same unique matched candidates
training.loss: unchanged Huber log optical-Z plus Huber normalized projected center offsets
training.freeze: Mobile and ResNet Depth; 48 LID, original HeightSplat unchanged
training.order: same perseed/fraction for both arms; nested location subsets hash order
training.stop: nonfinite loss/gradient or insufficient independent support

calibration.method: leave-one-calibration-location-out ridge log error diagnostics; final fit only calibration; group split independent of selection
calibration.radius: 90th percentile error / predicted_error on heldout calibration-location residuals; empirical, not certified conformal
calibration.threshold_selection: greatest calibration coverage meeting fixed quality and matched baseline gates, else abstain all

quality.comparison: same targets lower MAE and no worse P95 than geometry_prior and Fixed Plane; Dense summaries also reported

sealed: one final evaluation after source/checkpoint/threshold lock; no retrospective tuning
oracle_candidates: GT native visible instance regions diagnostic only; frozen M5-N models evaluated without retraining; never inference input
runtime: M5-M Partial inherited; no control or runtime matrix
limits: Calibration uses Town02 plus Town04 roads disjoint from Train by road_id and 150m; maps/road neighborhoods are isolation units, samples within positions correlated; randomized layout families shared.
